{{Quote|I've always wanted to match a Jedi against my saberfish.|Shon Ti'Ja decides to pit Obi-Wan Kenobi against his saberfish|<ref name="SC" />}}
'''Saberfish''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] with saber&ndash;like horns which sprouted from their foreheads. These horns were capable of clashing with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] without being broken and were used by the fish to attack. Saberfish were [[Color/Legends|purple]] in color with glowing white quills across their body as well as pink fins.<ref name="SC" /> In around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="SCt">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'' states the story is set during the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|the fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' which ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' stated took place c.[[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]], a pair of saberfish were owned by [[Shon Ti'Ja]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime boss]], who kept his pets in a [[Alekie Island menagerie|menagerie]] on [[Alkie island]]. When Ti'Ja set a trap in the menagerie for the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]], whom had sold weapons owned by the Nautolan to a [[Caylagos|rival]], he found that Pryce was accompanied by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Ta'Ja was thrilled to see the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as he wished to pit a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] against his fish. Kenobi and Pryce were dropped into a water tank containing the saberfish, whom the Jedi successfully fought off with his lightsaber before escaping the pit and defeating Ti'Ja.<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Saberfish first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2013]]. It was written by [[Justin Aclin]] and illustrated by [[Eduardo Ferrara]].
